name: Lateefah Simon
bio: a Representative from California; born in San Francisco, San Francisco County, Calif., January 29, 1977; B.A., Mills College, Oakland, Calif., 2009; M.P.A., University of San Francisco, San Francisco, Calif., 2022; non-profit executive; member of the Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) board of directors, 2016-2024, president, 2020-2024; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
